actions.operation: Create slot pattern (cut/slot feature patterned across a surface) on the top side

parameters.slot_cut_depth: TBD (prefer blind cut for plastic cover; through-all only if confirmed non-pressure, non-sealing region)
parameters.pattern_type: Rectangular pattern (X direction and Z direction)
parameters.keepout_regions: TBD (exclude filler/cap boss and any ribs/fasteners under top cover)
parameters.slot_orientation: Along Z (horizontal in right-view), unless airflow/structure requires X
parameters.edge_treatment: TBD (0.5-1.0 mm chamfer or fillet per side for plastic-friendly edges)

actions.target: Top surface of the plastic part
actions.relational_constraint: Pattern distributed across the top outer cover/rail surface; centered and bounded by an offset margin from the perimeter; avoid interfering features (cap/ports/bosses).
actions.unresolved_reference: The multiview images show a black top cover with a central circular boss/cap; exact available flat area and underside ribbing are unknown. Need slot size, spacing, orientation intent (aesthetic, venting, weight reduction), and whether cuts must be blind (recommended) or through. Also need explicit keep-out diameter around the central top boss and clearance from corner mounts/ports.
steps: Localization/face selection: Select SEC-01 (Radiator core + perimeter frame) top outer planar face 'Core/Frame top outer plane' (face_code 0000, Brep FACE 46, plane y = 174.851756). This is the visually black top band/cover area in top and toprightiso views.

Create sketch plane: Start a sketch directly on face_code 0000 (or create an offset construction plane 0.0 mm from this face if the CAD system requires a stable reference). Set sketch orientation so X is left-right across the radiator width and Z is depth (front-back).

Define pattern boundary: Project the outer perimeter edges of the top cover onto the sketch. Create an inner 'no-slot' boundary by offsetting the projected perimeter inward by edge_margin (TBD). Additionally, sketch a circular/obround keep-out around the top central boss/cap visible in the top view (keepout_regions TBD).

Create the seed slot: Draw a center-point slot (or two semicircles + tangent lines) with slot_length (TBD) and slot_width (TBD), with end radius = slot_width/2. Constrain the slot’s centerline orientation (slot_orientation default along Z). Place the seed slot within the allowed boundary region and dimension its location relative to projected edges (e.g., centered between left and right edges and offset from the keep-out).

Cut feature: Finish sketch and perform an Extrude-Cut from face_code 0000 into the body in the -Y direction. Use slot_cut_depth (TBD). Prefer 'Blind' to preserve any sealing/structural requirements of the top cover; use 'Through All' only if confirmed safe and non-sealing.

Pattern the cut: Apply a 2D rectangular pattern of the cut feature in X and Z directions. Set pattern_count_x / pattern_pitch_x and pattern_count_z / pattern_pitch_z (all TBD). Use 'extent' or 'fill within boundary' if available; otherwise, ensure patterned instances do not cross the offset boundary or enter keep-out regions (suppress violating instances).

Edge treatment for plastic: Apply chamfer/fillet to the slot edges on face_code 0000 (and optionally the internal cut edges) per edge_treatment (TBD) to reduce stress risers and improve moldability/handling.

Validation: Check interference/clearance against nearby sections (SEC-02/SEC-03 ports, SEC-07 mounting tabs, SEC-04 shroud interface). Ensure remaining ligament widths meet structural intent of SEC-01 (stiff perimeter rail supporting fan/shroud loads).

actions.operation: Create slot pattern (cut/slot feature patterned across a surface) on the bottom side

parameters.slot_cut_depth: Match top (TBD); direction opposite (into +Y from bottom face)
parameters.pattern_type: Rectangular pattern (X direction and Z direction)
parameters.keepout_regions: TBD (exclude drain/aux fittings or low bosses seen near bottom edges)
parameters.registration_method: Mirror of top pattern about the mid-plane between top and bottom rails (or reuse same sketch dimensions referenced to global planes)

actions.target: Bottom surface of the plastic part
actions.relational_constraint: Pattern distributed across the bottom outer cover/rail surface; intended to match/register with the top-side pattern unless conflicting with fittings/mount features.
actions.unresolved_reference: Bottom view shows a black bottom cover with nearby hose/aux features at the ends; exact keep-out regions and whether bottom must be identical to top (mirrored) are not specified. Need confirmation of symmetry requirement and any no-cut zones for fittings, mounts, or sealing surfaces.
steps: Localization/face selection: Select SEC-01 bottom outer planar face 'Core/Frame bottom outer plane' (face_code 0003, Brep FACE 22, plane y = -171.450000). This corresponds to the visually black bottom band/cover area in bottom and toprightiso views.

Create sketch plane: Start a sketch on face_code 0003 (or create an offset construction plane 0.0 mm from this face). Align sketch axes consistently with the top sketch (X across width, Z depth) to ensure pattern registration.

Register to top pattern intent: If the design intent is identical patterns, either (a) mirror the top cut feature pattern across a global mid-plane between top and bottom (preferred for robust linkage), or (b) reuse the same seed slot sketch dimensions and pattern parameters, constrained to common datum planes/edges.

Define pattern boundary + keep-outs: Project bottom perimeter edges and offset inward by edge_margin (TBD). Add keep-out sketches around any fittings/ports/bosses that could be affected on the bottom side (not fully defined in model.json; to be confirmed).

Create seed slot (if not mirrored): Draw the same slot geometry (slot_length/slot_width) and position it to match the top pattern registration. Constrain by symmetry/dimensions to datums to maintain alignment.
Cut feature: Extrude-Cut from face_code 0003 into the body in the +Y direction by slot_cut_depth (TBD). Use the same cut termination type as top (Blind recommended unless confirmed through).
Pattern the cut: Apply the same 2D rectangular pattern parameters (count/pitch) as the top, suppressing any instances that violate the boundary/keep-outs.
Edge treatment for plastic: Apply the same chamfer/fillet to slot edges per edge_treatment (TBD).

Validation: Confirm no breakthrough into critical internal volumes or interfaces; verify minimum wall thickness remaining under slots and that the bottom rail retains sufficient stiffness for SEC-01’s load path to SEC-04 shroud and SEC-07 mounts.

intention: Add a slot pattern across the plastic part surface on both the top and bottom sides.
Maintain structural integrity of the perimeter rail/cover while adding repeated cut features, and keep the top and bottom patterns registered unless blocked by fittings or mounting features.
